title: Network & access
subtitle: How the hub is reached, and who can open this admin page.
endpoints_footer: Auto-discovered IPv6 / LAN addresses plus the ones configured above. They're rediscovered with the new config after a restart.
security_footer: These affect what the app trusts. Change them only in the security section of hub.json on the hub machine.
trusted_cidrs_hint: security.trusted_cidrs: sources in these ranges count as LAN
public_plaintext_hint: security.allow_public_plaintext: lets the internet reach the app API over plain HTTP
access_saved: Access changed. It applies right away
access_title: Who can open the admin page
access_footer: Outside the range, /admin looks like any missing page, so nobody can tell there's an admin page. You can only narrow the range here. To widen it, run {command} on the hub machine or use the deploy script.
access_env_title: Set by PERSONA_ADMIN_ACCESS at deploy time
access_env_body: This hub's environment sets the access range, so it can't be changed here. Edit the value in .env (or systemd's Environment), then restart the hub.
access_wider: Wider than the current range. Only the hub machine can widen it
cidrs_hint_narrow: One per line. You can only remove ranges or make them smaller.
cidrs_hint: One per line, e.g. 192.0.2.0/24 or your VPN's range.
lockout_body: Your address {address} isn't in "{scope}". After the change you won't be able to open this page; to widen it again, run {command} on the hub machine.
public_saved: Saved. Restart the hub to apply
public_footer: Saved to hub.json; takes effect after the hub restarts. Entering an address doesn't open ports, change the firewall, or update DNS.
public_url_env: Set by PERSONA_PUBLIC_URL at deploy time (Docker's .env). Change it there
public_url_hint: Address in the pairing QR code. Older clients use it too
tls_listen_on: Listening on {listen}, fingerprint {fp}…. Leave empty to turn TLS off (Persona Link and linked hubs need it)
tls_listen_hint: e.g. :18662. Once on, internet access and linked hubs use only this port. Turning it on the first time creates a self-signed certificate
advertise_hint: One per line. Full HTTPS URLs work best, such as a domain kept up to date with DDNS
password_saved: Password changed. Other sign-ins were signed out
password_footer: Changing the password signs out every other browser. If you forget it, run personad hub admin reset-password on the hub machine.
